1) Failure of the flush in the final beat. The "write completed line" block at the bottom of the always block overrides the flush and re-sets valid_arr, so the next fetch hits stale data.

2) Bits used for tag acc header is 26 but we actually use 50 bits. 


Tests:

Test	What it covers
T1–T3	Smoke, all 16 word offsets, latency modes
T4	Sweep of all 256 sets
T5	Each of the 50 tag bits flipped individually, which must miss
T6	A-B-A-B conflict thrash
T7	1024-word streaming across lines
T8	Address edges
T9	FENCE.I basics, including flush together with a hit and with a miss
T10	FENCE.I at every refill beat, at two latencies
T11	Reset mid-refill
T12	cpu_addr changing mid-refill (known-issue mode)
T13	20k constrained-random operations with random flushes, idles, and aborted fetches
